name: fireline-examples-discovery
description: Discovery-only external consumer examples for Fireline managed-agent surfaces.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:surface
scripts.smoke:curl-shell-raw-http: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-curl-shell-raw-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- sh examples/07-curl-shell-raw-http/run.sh'
scripts.smoke:python-raw-http: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-python-raw-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- python3 examples/09-python-raw-http/run.py'
scripts.smoke:rust-raw-http: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-rust-raw-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-/tmp/fireline-mono-oet-29-3-9-target} FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- cargo run --quiet --manifest-path examples/10-rust-raw-http/Cargo.toml'
scripts.smoke:go-raw-http: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-go-raw-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- go run examples/15-go-raw-http/main.go'
scripts.smoke:vercel-edge-runtime: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-vercel-edge-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- sh -c "pnpm run build:vercel-edge-runtime >/dev/null && tsx examples/13-vercel-edge-runtime/src/run-local.ts"'
scripts.smoke:bun: sh -c 'CONTROL_STREAM=${FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM:-fireline-bun-control}; STREAMS_PORT=${FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT:-7474}; FIRELINE_STREAMS_PORT="$STREAMS_PORT" FIRELINE_CONTROL_STREAM="$CONTROL_STREAM" fireline-v3-dev --state-stream "$CONTROL_STREAM" -- bun examples/14-bun/src/run.ts'
